title: TransportContract
description: The agreement between a customer and a carrier for one shipment, written by the carrier to its eVault after the customer accepted a TransportOffer. Signatures are not fields of this record: both parties sign it through the existing SigningEnvelope / EIDSignature schemas, which reference this envelope. schema.org has no contract type; the offer link follows Order.acceptedOffer.

authorId.description: eName of whoever drew up the contract on the carrier's behalf

carrierEName.description: eName of the carrier organisation responsible for the shipment

shipmentRequest.description: The ShipmentRequest the contract implements, as w3ds://envelope?id=@<ename>/<metaEnvelopeId>

acceptedOffer.description: The TransportOffer the contract is based on, as w3ds://envelope?id=@<ename>/<metaEnvelopeId> (schema.org: acceptedOffer)

priceType.description: 'fixed': the customer price does not change when execution costs change; 'estimate': it may

serviceScope.description: Part of the journey the carrier is responsible for

preferredDeliveryDays.description: Agreed preferred delivery time, in days from pickup

latestDeliveryDays.description: Agreed latest delivery time, in days from pickup

updatedAt.description: When the record was last updated
